answer: One concrete mechanism: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because timber only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, terrace is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any forge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
